page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; margin notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.l: opus esse videretur. Gaudebat quippe
utraque pars fœdere, ejusque fructu sua-
viter afficiebatur. Itaque data utrimque
opera est, ut ampliatum rebus & tempore
denuò feriretur. Idque confectum exeun-
te anno M. CCCC. LXXXII, triduò ante
natalem Domini: tempus ei decretum
superiore majus. Ejus capita præcipua
fuére hæc, ut sunt in Historiâ à me ex-
pressa: Pax inter partes esset, salvo cui-
que legitimo jure suo; auxiliis se mutuò ju-
varent, si res auxiliis egeret; temerè nemo in
exilium pelleretur, nisi criminum gravium
reus, & contumax: ex legibus sese mutuò
convenirent, omni vi missâ: Principes ex-
ternos, & quoscunque alios vim sociis affe-
rentes, aut libertatem prementes communi
operâ pro viribus arcerent: postulati auxilia
ferrent ad arbitrium bonorum virorum, &
statim, & suis sumptibus; cessantesq; in
hoc officio ꝓM[?]. scutatos veteres in usum ap-
paratus bellici penderent: tumultuantes
comprimerentur maturè: si qui turbatâ pace
publicâ ceperint alios, ac spoliarint, captos
dimitterent confestim, spolioque duplicitèr
restituto insuper gravem multam fœderi

page.notes: The right-margin notes are printed in four lines, set beside the text lines; they are placed where they stand and read together as: "Fœdus postremum cum vicinis in A-gro, & celeberrimû." The "e:" in the note is printed with a colon, possibly an e- hyphen; left as printed. The reference-like sign before "M." in "officio ꝓM[?]." is unclear. The word "statim" and other long-s forms are written with plain s. Printed hyphens kept on note words.
